problem_miss_most: Having regular assignments and deadlines that force them to practice different skills.
problem_faded_skill_when: Every few weeks. Usually looks through old notes or searches online because they remember the concept but not how to apply it.
problem_priority: Keeping skills fresh, especially technical skills needed for interviews.

screen_price_payer: $5/month, personally, if the recommendations are useful.

problem_miss_most: Daily coding practice and feedback from instructors.
problem_faded_skill_when: Almost every week. They often forget syntax or how to work with certain frameworks and spend time reviewing tutorials.
problem_priority: Learning new skills for the job.
screen_upload_reason: The bootcamp curriculum is useful, but they are unsure whether the record contains enough information about what they learned.
confusion_points: I didn't know if I was supposed to answer based on what I learned or what I would do at work.

job_social: Like a developer who can contribute immediately.

problem_miss_most: Having a clear learning path and knowing which skills to practice next.
problem_faded_skill_when: About once a month. They usually watch parts of the course again because they have forgotten specific Excel or SQL functions.
screen_upload_reason: They already have a certificate and would prefer the system to identify the covered skills automatically.
confusion_points: The skill names were a little too technical. I didn't recognize one even though I knew the topic.
needs_basic: Simple explanations and beginner-friendly practice questions.
needs_performance: Connects course skills to entry-level data analyst tasks.
needs_delight: A progress report showing how much of the certificate knowledge they still remember.
job_functional: Use the certificate to transition into a data analyst role.
job_social: Someone who can use the knowledge from their certificate.
top_themes: Unclear skill terminology, need for beginner-friendly explanations.

problem_miss_most: Knowing which academic skills employers expect them to remember.
problem_faded_skill_when: Every few weeks during job applications. Sometimes they skip applying for jobs because they no longer feel confident about certain technical requirements.
problem_priority: Something else: preparing for job interviews.
screen_upload_reason: They would upload a course list but feel uncomfortable sharing a full transcript with grades.
screen_price_payer: Would only use a free version because they are unemployed.
confusion_points: I don't understand how this score relates to whether I'm ready for a job.
needs_basic: Clear connection between practice activities and actual job requirements.
needs_performance: Identifies skills missing from specific job postings.
needs_delight: The ability to paste a job description and get a personalized practice plan.
job_functional: Improve interview performance and get a business analyst job.

screen_upload_reason: Training records are already available through the company's learning management system, so integration would make adoption easier.
screen_price_payer: $3 to $7 per employee/month, paid by the employer.
confusion_points: I'm not sure how the system distinguishes forgetting from never learning the skill properly.
schedule_fit: At the start of the workday or after training.

job_emotional: Confident that training investments produce results.

top_themes: LMS integration, team-level reporting, difference between forgotten and never-learned skills.

problem_miss_most: The habit of regularly discussing concepts and applying them in different contexts.

problem_priority: Learning new skills for the job.

screen_price_payer: Would not pay personally, but might use it if the employer provided access.
confusion_points: I don't really see why I need to review this when I can just look it up when I need it.

needs_basic: Obvious relevance to a current task or job.

job_emotional: Productive rather than obligated to study.
top_themes: Preference for on-demand learning, resistance to daily study requirements.
